cc:Work.dc:title: Census Sync v1 order-to-destination flow diagram

svg.title: Census Sync v1 order-to-destination flow diagram
svg.desc: A user selects an external destination for an order, then finalizes the order which triggers async backend table creation. The system polls for setup completion, looping until ready. The user then configures the sync object, behavior, and field mapping. Mapping is validated before a summary modal confirms and creates the sync, looping back to mapping if validation fails.
svg.text: Two loops: polling for setup, re-validating field mapping
